engine_rules.name: Seventh Forms as Cycle Origin and Target
engine_rules.preference: default to catalog seventh form at each cycle node
engine_rules.anchor: Seventh Chord Forms

engine_rules.name: Augmented Form as Chromatic Approach Vehicle
engine_rules.preference: sustain augmented color across multiple beats before resolving
engine_rules.falsifier: augmented chord used as tonic with no subsequent cycle resolution
engine_rules.anchor: Augmented Chord Forms

engine_rules.name: Minor Form as ii-Chord in ii-V-I
engine_rules.preference: use catalog minor form at ii position before chromatic approach to V
engine_rules.falsifier: minor form used at tonic position in major key
engine_rules.anchor: Minor Chord Forms

engine_rules.name: Diminished Form as Mobile Approach Chord
engine_rules.preference: treat diminished voicing as approach rather than destination
engine_rules.falsifier: diminished chord used as stable tonic with no subsequent resolution
engine_rules.anchor: Diminished Chord Forms

engine_rules.name: Half-Diminished Form as iio in Minor Cadence
engine_rules.preference: resolve half-diminished to dominant 7b9 then to augmented
engine_rules.falsifier: half-diminished form used at tonic position
engine_rules.anchor: Minor Seventh Flat Fifth Chord Forms

_provenance.section_title: Minor Seventh Flat Fifth Chord Forms

engine_rules.name: Tritone Substitute for Major-Sound Resolution
engine_rules.preference: prefer tritone sub (bII7) over direct V7 when resolving to major tonic
engine_rules.falsifier: tritone sub used in context where resolution target is minor or non-tonic
engine_rules.anchor: G13b5 (or Db7+9b5) which re-solves into Cma9

engine_rules.name: Cma9 as Major-Sound Tonic Resolution Target
engine_rules.preference: add ninth to major tonic voicing when arriving via tritone sub
engine_rules.falsifier: plain major triad used as tonic after tritone sub resolution
engine_rules.anchor: G13b5 (or Db7+9b5) which re-solves into Cma9

engine_rules.name: Db7 as Tritone Substitute for G7
engine_rules.preference: use Db7+9b5 voicing shape when substituting for G13
engine_rules.falsifier: G7 used directly without tritone sub option in major resolution passage
engine_rules.anchor: G13b5 (or Db7+9b5) which re-solves into Cma9

engine_rules.name: Chromatic Approach Chord Between ii and V
engine_rules.preference: insert chromatic dominant (bVI13) between ii and V for smooth bass descent
engine_rules.falsifier: direct ii-V motion with no chromatic approach chord
engine_rules.anchor: movement in Dm7, resolving into Abl13 to G13

engine_rules.name: Bass Descends by Half-Step into Dominant
engine_rules.preference: use bVI13 voicing whose root is a half-step above the V root
engine_rules.falsifier: approach chord a whole step or tritone away from V root
engine_rules.anchor: resolving into Abl13 to G13

engine_rules.name: Substitute Turnaround Replacing I-VI-II-V
engine_rules.preference: prefer substitute turnaround over standard I-VI-II-V when returning to G13
engine_rules.falsifier: standard I-VI-II-V used when substitute turnaround passage is available
engine_rules.anchor: substitute turn-around back to G13

engine_rules.name: Cycle-of-Fifths as Default Seventh-Chord Traversal
engine_rules.preference: follow cycle of fifths as default armature for connecting seventh-chord members
engine_rules.anchor: followed by a cycle seventh movement

engine_rules.name: Diminished Chord Resolves Freely to Multiple Targets
engine_rules.preference: treat destination as open; any resolution target is valid
engine_rules.anchor: Resolve the last chord in this sequence into any chord

engine_rules.name: Diminished Resolution via ii-V-I Path
engine_rules.preference: prefer Dm7-G7-Cma7 resolution path when targeting major tonic
engine_rules.falsifier: diminished chord resolving directly to tonic without ii or V intermediary
engine_rules.anchor: Dm7 — G7 — Cma'7

engine_rules.name: Diminished Resolution via Chromatic Descending Bass Path
engine_rules.preference: prefer chromatic descending bass path (Em7-Eb9-Dm9-Db9) when targeting minor sound
engine_rules.falsifier: non-chromatic bass motion in this resolution path
engine_rules.anchor: Em7 — Eb9 — Dm9 — Db9

engine_rules.name: Diminished Voicing Substitutes for Dominant 7b9
engine_rules.preference: use diminished voicing wherever 7b9 appears; treat as freely interchangeable
engine_rules.falsifier: 7b9 chord that cannot be replaced by its corresponding diminished form
engine_rules.anchor: Use of diminished chords for seventh flat ninth chord movement

engine_rules.name: Diminished 7b9 Substitution Anchored to I-VI-II-V Skeleton
engine_rules.preference: apply diminished-for-7b9 substitution at VI and V positions in the I-VI-II-V pattern
engine_rules.falsifier: diminished substitution outside of recognizable harmonic skeleton
engine_rules.anchor: utilizing the basic pattern of A7 — Dm — G7 —C

engine_rules.name: Augmented Chord Sustained as Pre-Cadential Color
engine_rules.preference: sustain augmented voicing across multiple chord positions before chromatic resolution
engine_rules.falsifier: augmented chord used as a single passing chord with no sustained color function
engine_rules.anchor: first six chords are basically G aug. Movement is used chromatically to get to the basic cycle

engine_rules.name: Augmented Resolved Chromatically into Cycle Cadence
engine_rules.preference: resolve augmented color via half-step voice leading into the first chord of the cycle
engine_rules.falsifier: augmented chord resolved by leap rather than chromatic motion
engine_rules.anchor: Movement is used chromatically to get to the basic cycle (A7 — D7 —G)

engine_rules.name: Chord Symbol Qualifier Order Equals Ascending Voice Order
engine_rules.falsifier: chord voicing where qualifier order in symbol does not match ascending string order
engine_rules.anchor: order of appearance of notes coincides with the spelling of the chord symbol

engine_rules.name: D7+9+5 Assigns Raised Ninth to Middle Voice, Raised Fifth to Top
engine_rules.preference: place raised ninth in next available voice above D7 core; place raised fifth on top string
engine_rules.falsifier: D7+9+5 voiced with raised fifth below raised ninth
engine_rules.anchor: D7+9+5 means D7 with the raised 9th next, and the raised 5th on top

engine_rules.name: Sustain Common Top-Voice Note Across Chord Change
engine_rules.preference: always sustain rather than rearticulate a top-voice note that is common to both chords
engine_rules.falsifier: rearticulation of common top-voice note between C9 and F13
engine_rules.anchor: Try to sustain lead notes from one chord to the next. For example, C9 to F13, sustain the G on top

engine_rules.name: G Sustained on Top Across C9 to F13
engine_rules.preference: use voicing shapes for C9 and F13 that share G on the same top string
engine_rules.falsifier: C9 and F13 voiced without G on top
engine_rules.anchor: C9 to F13, sustain the G on top

engine_rules.name: Half-Diminished Moves Through Dominant 7b9 to Augmented
engine_rules.preference: resolve half-diminished through 7b9 dominant to augmented, not directly to tonic
engine_rules.falsifier: half-diminished resolving directly to tonic without 7b9 and augmented intermediaries
engine_rules.anchor: A7b9 to Dm7}5 resolving finally to G aug

_provenance.section_title: Minor Seventh Flat Fifth to Seventh Passage

engine_rules.name: Half-Diminished to Augmented Requires Specific Voicing Shapes
engine_rules.preference: inspect and memorize the specific voicing shapes rather than any generic half-dim form
engine_rules.falsifier: generic half-diminished voicing substituted without regard to specific catalog shape
engine_rules.anchor: Notice the chords used to obtain these sounds

_provenance.section_title: Minor Seventh Flat Fifth to Augmented Sounds
